audience: developers and ML engineers who run models and dedicated GPU deployments on DeepInfra

useCases.title: Check spend and token usage for a billing period
useCases.text: The AI reads spend for a billing period and token usage per model. It also reads GPU rental usage for a time range and lists invoices, so you see where the cost comes from.

useCases.title: Find models and compare their price and context length
useCases.text: The AI lists the model catalog and reads one model entry with its pricing, context length and capabilities. You can compare models for a task such as embeddings.

useCases.title: Check how a dedicated deployment is doing
useCases.text: The AI reads a dedicated deployment with its config and status, plus time-series stats for throughput, latency and replicas. It can also query the request logs of a time window.

useCases.title: Check GPU availability and hardware for a deployment
useCases.text: The AI reads which GPUs can be provisioned for LLM deployments now, and the hardware options for a given model. It helps you plan a new deployment.

useCases.title: Start or stop a dedicated deployment
useCases.text: The AI stops a running dedicated deployment to end GPU charges, or starts a stopped one. Starting a deployment may add GPU charges while it runs.
